task.description: Implement POST /api/v1/packages endpoint for storing packages.
task.rationale: API endpoint for delivery agents to store packages in lockers.
acceptanceCriteria: Request body: reference, size (SMALL, MEDIUM, LARGE)
Response includes: packageId, lockerCode, pickupCode (plaintext, once only)
Error handling: no suitable locker available, invalid size
task.implementationNotes: Created Zod schemas for request/response validation (packageSchemas.ts). Implemented POST /api/v1/packages endpoint (packageRoutes.ts) with StorePackageUseCase integration. Created PostgreSQL repository implementations (PackageRepositoryPostgres, StorageAssignmentRepositoryPostgres). Wired up routes in server.ts. Error mapping: 400 validation, 409 duplicate, 422 no locker, 500 storage failure.
task.testEvidence: API endpoint accepts reference and size, returns packageId/lockerCode/pickupCode on success. Comprehensive error handling with appropriate HTTP status codes. Schemas validated with Zod.
